data: What is approximately the highest ROUGE-2 F-1 score achieved by the orange line?

From the analysis of the figure, the orange line (TITLE+FILTER) shows a relatively flat trend with some minor fluctuations. The highest point of the orange line appears to be around 0.2235. Therefore, the approximate highest ROUGE-2 F-1 score achieved by the orange line is 0.2235.
